status: removable fan guide prototype; material and load tests required

screw.part: M2 x 4 A2 Phillips pan head, ISO 7045 / DIN 7985 H
screw.hole_note: The CAD bore clears the installed thread envelope. It is not a finished pilot or tap drill. Confirm the thread process, torque and heated pull strength in the selected insulating material.

sequence: remove the deck and release its attached devices and wiring
release J320 and park the keyboard FFC clear of the carrier
release the keyboard retention and lift out the keyboard
remove the five fan-guide screws and two USB bracket screws
support the loose guides and loom, then lift the carrier vertically
access J52 and the module display connector
service.limits: The deck attachments, keyboard retention and full FFC route are unfinished. The lift checks cover the retained CAD only. Support the detached guides without loading the fan wires; this requires a dressed physical service trial.
